This '''[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]''' were distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|yellow]] skin, including the cluster of [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]] they used for locomotion, as well as a lumpy patch on the front of their face. Their heads resembled those of many [[Bird/Legends|avian]] species, covered in blue feathers, and featuring an orange [[Mouth/Legends|beak]], as well as squinted [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Two members of this species visited the [[Bovris Tapcafe/Legends|Bovris Tapcafe]] on [[planet]] [[Ifron/Legends|Ifron]]<ref name="MJ5" /> during [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Text">Date established in the issue's narrative text.</ref>.
